description:
Christmas. Hotel. A special day, a secret story in a special place. We didn't know what you'd like, so we prepared a bit of everything.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

 **Release includes:**
1-3. **Namsachin Sayongbeop** (남사친 사용법, How to Use Male Friends) by Sao
4-7. **In the Hotel, in the Body** (인더호텔 온더베드) by Rako
8-10. **My X-MAS Report** (마이 X-MAS 리포트) by Geumgal. *Boys' Love.*
11-13. **Bisanggyedan** (비상계단; Emergency Stairs) by Mamo. *Boys' Love.*
14-17. **Christmas Revenge** (크리스마스 리벤지) by Golji
18-22. **Santa-ga Jakku Sowoneul Deureojundago Hamnida** (산타가 자꾸 소원을 들어준다고 합니다; Santa Keeps Saying He'll Grant My Wishes) by Merin. *Boys' Love.*
23-25. **Love Script** (러브 스크립트) by Jeo Si. *Boys' Love.*
26-28. **Punch Drunken Love** (펀치드렁큰러브) by Ginga. *Boys' Love.*
29-31. **Un-holy night** by Gangtto Key. *Boys' Love.*
32-34. **Daeum Seukejureun 2501Hoeseo** (다음 스케줄은 2501호에서; Next Meeting is in Room 2501) by Hui-Yeol Park
